auth_forgot_subtitle: Injira muri iyo imeyili kuri konti yawe. Tuzorungika uruja n’uruza rwo gusubiramwo nimba ruhuye n’uwukoresha yiyandikishije.

auth_otp_resent: Kode nshasha yoherejwe kuri imeyili yawe.
auth_otp_email_missing: Email irakenewe kugira ngo umuntu asuzume kode.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Injira muri kode y'imibare 6 ivuye muri porogaramu yawe y'ukwemeza.
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Wemeze ijambobanga ryawe kugira ngo ubone kode QR y’ukwemeza.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Scan ukoresheje app yawe y’ukwemeza, hanyuma winjize kode y’imirongo 6.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Izo kode uzibike ahantu hatagira inkomanzi. Kode yose ishobora gukoreshwa rimwe.
auth_2fa_account_enabled_hint: Konti yawe irindwa n’iporogarama y’ugushingira intahe.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Injira ijambobanga ryawe kugira ngo uzime ivyemezo vy’ibintu bibiri.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Subirizaho umugenzuzi wawe. Ama apps asanzweho azohagarika gukora gushika ukoresheje scanner ya QR nshasha.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Wemeze ijambobanga ryawe kugira ngo usubirize kode yawe ya QR y’ukwemeza.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Injira ijambobanga ryawe. Amakode y’ububiko y’imbere azohagarika gukora.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Amakode mashasha yo gusubiza inyuma arateguwe. Bakize ahantu hatagira umutekano.
session_extend_description: Wemeze ijambobanga ryawe kugira ngo wongere amasaha 2 kuri iki kiganiro.
session_extend_password_hint: Injira ijambobanga rya konti winjiyemwo. Ushobora kwongerako rimwe mu kiganiro.
session_extend_already_extended: Ico kiganiro cari caramaze kwagurwa rimwe.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Mu gihe co gutegura ushobora gucapura QR imwe ukoresheje ibikoresho birenze kimwe.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Ivyemezo bibiri birakenewe ku bw’ico gikorwa. Bishireho kugira ngo bibandanye.
set_new_password_description: Gushinga ijambobanga rishasha kuri konti yawe.
enter_email_reset_description: Injira muri email yawe tuzokwoherereza link yo gusubiramwo ijambobanga ryawe.
invalid_reset_link: Ihuza ry'ugusubiramwo ritagira akamaro canke ryaheze. Ndagusavye usabe uwundi mushasha aha hepfo.
password_min_length: Ijambobanga ritegerezwa kuba rifise nibura inyuguti 8.
reset_email_sent: Niba hariho konti y'iyi imeyili, urubuga rwo gusubiramwo ijambobanga rwarungitswe.
password_reset_success: Ijambobanga ryasubiwemwo neza. Ubu ushobora kwinjira.
op_billing_select_visit_hint: Hitamwo urugendo kugira ngo utangure gutanga amafaranga OP.
op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Iryo tegeko ryacapwe; igiciro c’urugero rw’ugusura ntigishobora guhindurwa.

op_billing_bill_close_blocked_nursing: Ubuvuzi bushitse ntiburangiye; bill ntishobora gupfungwa.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Nta bikorwa vyuzuye bitegerejwe gutanga amafaranga y’uru rugendo.
op_billing_no_services_found: Nta bikorwa vyarangijwe bitegerejwe gutanga amafaranga y’uru rugendo.
op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Rangira ubuvuzi bushitse ku mirongo yose y’ibikorwa imbere y’uko ufunga.
op_billing_bill_close_blocked_no_lines: Nta mirongo ishobora gufatwa kuri iri fagitire.
ip_billing_select_visit_hint: Hitamwo gusura kugira ngo utangure gutanga amafaranga IP.
ip_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Iryo tegeko ryacapwe; igiciro c’urugero rw’ugusura ntigishobora guhindurwa.

no_hospital_assigned: Nta bitaro vyashizwe kuri konti yawe. Baza umuyobozi wawe.

hospital_coding_system_help: Iboha iki kigo c’ubuvuzi ku rugero rumwe rwa OMS rwo gupima indwara. Ntibishobora guhinduka inyuma y'aho ibipimo vy'amakode bihari.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Coding system irafunze kuko iki kigo c’ubuvuzi gisanzwe gifise amakode y’ibipimo.
icd_who_attribution: ICD-10 n’ibirimwo ICD-11 ni uburenganzira bw’umuhinguzi w’ishirahamwe mpuzamakungu ry’ubuzima (OMS). ICD-11 ifise uruhusha rwo gukoresha CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Gukoresha bisaba gushingira intahe; ivyo guhindura bikeneye uruhusha rwa OMS.
docs_coding_standards_body: Ibitaro vyose bifatanya uburyo bumwe bwo gupima indwara bwa OMS (ICD-10 canke ICD-11 MMS) ku gihe co kurema. EMR gupima ubushakashatsi bukoresha iyo kataloge gusa. Ivyandiko vyuzuye biva hanze biciye ku ICD-API ya OMS mu meza rusangi.
name: Izina
admin_overview_subtitle: Ibara n'inzira ngufi zo gutwara sisitemu.
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Nta bitaro biracariho. Rema imwe maze ubohe nyen’iyo.
admin_team_subtitle: Tuma abafasha maze ushireho amapaje y’ubuyobozi bashobora gukoresha.
admin_team_need_view: Nibura urupapuro rumwe rutegerezwa kuba rufise uruhusha rwo kubona.
admin_team_invite_hint: Bazoronka email yo gusubiramwo ijambobanga kugira ngo bashireho ijambobanga ryabo.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Kubona birakenewe imbere yo kurema, guhindura canke gufuta kuri paji.
admin_team_reset_failed: Ntishobora kohereza ijambobanga ryo gusubiramwo imeyili.
admin_team_revoked: Uburenganzira bwo gushika ku bagize ikipe bwasubiwemwo.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Ikoreshwa, igikorwa gishasha, n'ubuzima bw'urutonde rw'amakuru.
admin_staff_subtitle: Abakoresha bose bafise uruhara rw’abakozi mu bitaro vyose.
admin_ops_subtitle: Ikoreshwa ry'ubuzima, igikorwa gishasha, n'ubuzima bw'urutonde rw'amakuru.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Ivyigwa n'ivyo biherutse kurema bivuye mu rutonde rw'amakuru.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: Igitigiri c'imigambi ntikigaragazwa biciye kuri SQL. Raba Neon console ku bubiko buriho.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Ingano y'urutonde rw'amakuru iva kuri PostgreSQL pg_urutonde_rw'amakuru (ingano y'ubwenge kuri iri shami rya Neon).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Igitigiri c'ububiko bw'umugambi wa Neon ntikiboneka biciye kuri SQL. Ikoreshwa vs iboneka bisaba console ya Neon canke API ya Neon.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Ibara ry'umurongo w'imbonerahamwe ni COUNT(*) ku mbonerahamwe nyamukuru, si ibiharuro vya pg_stat.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Itohoza ry'ihuriro ryananiwe. Suzuma DATABASE_URL n'ishami rya Neon.
no_owners_yet: Nta ba nyen’ivyo bafise. Mushireho imwe kugira ngo bashobore gushika mu bitaro.
no_user_groups_yet: Nta migwi y'abakoresha iracariho. Rema imwe yo guha abakozi.
no_user_groups_create: Nta migwi y'abakoresha. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
no_branches_yet: Nta mashami aracariho. Wongereko ishami ry’iki kigo c’ubuvuzi.
no_departments_create: Nta n’amashami. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
no_stores_create: Nta maduka. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
no_user_groups: Nta migwi y’abakoresha iriho kuri iki kigo c’ubuvuzi.
user_groups_optional_hint: Hitamwo umugwi umwe canke myinshi y'abakoresha (ntibikenewe).
store_central_help: Nibura imwe ku ishami. GRN ishira ibintu muri iri duka. Niba usanzwe ufise iduka ry’imbere kuri iri shami, rizimye ng’aho imbere y’uko rifungura hano.
no_items_master_create: Nta bintu. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: Ama scanner ya USB akenshi yandika mu kibanza cibandako. Gucapura kamera birashobora kwongerwako mu nyuma.
item_master_batch_required_help: Iyo bishobojwe, ikimenyetso c'uko ibicuruzwa vyakiriwe bitegerezwa kubamwo inomero y'umugwi, itariki y'iherezo, n'igiciro co kugura iki kintu (bisanzwe mu farumasi).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Hitamwo igice c'ikintu mbere, hanyuma ukoreshe Ivyashizweho kugira ngo uhuze n'impinduka zirimwo.
Nta mpinduka zikoresha iki kintu ku kugura canke ku gutanga.
item_master_unit_conversions_search_plac: Akayungurura hakurikijwe umwandiko wo guhindura canke id...
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Hitamwo mburabuzi mu bihinduwe vy'ibice birimwo.
item_master_category_hint: Ivy’Itanga Rusangi gusa, Ivy’Ifarumasi, canke Ivy’Ubuvuzi (bivuye ku Mukuru w’Iciciro).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Hitamwo umuti rusangi ku bikoresho vy’Ivuriro.
no_suppliers_create: Nta bacuruzi. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Nta miti y’ivyatsi. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
unit_master_empty: Nta ma unités aracariho. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
item_unit_master_purchase_factor: Ikintu co kugura (ishimikiro ku kintu 1 co kugura)
item_unit_master_factors_positive: Ibintu bitegerezwa kuba ari imibare myiza.
no_item_unit_profiles: Nta n’abahindutse. Rema imwe iri hejuru.
confirm_delete_refer: Urazi neza ko ushaka gukuraho iyi reference?
support_select_ticket: Hitamwo itike kugira ngo ubone ido n’ido.
support_unauthorized: Utegerezwa kwinjira kugira ngo ukoreshe ubufasha.
nursing_case_sheet_save_success: Urupapuro rw’ivyabaye rwabitswe ku bifatanijwe n’umurwayi.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Inaniwe kubika urupapuro rw'ibibazo ku bifatanijwe n'umurwayi.
clinical_document_save_failed: Inaniwe kubika urupapuro ku bifatanye n'abarwayi.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Hitamwo urugendo ukoresheje ubuto 'Hitamwo urugendo' buri hejuru kugira ngo ubone urupapuro rw'urubanza.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Hitamwo urugendo ukoresheje ubuto 'Hitamwo urugendo' buri hejuru kugira ngo ubone amakuru y'ivyo wihweje.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Uru rugendo rwazigamye nk’uko rwashizweko umukono. Kwihweza no guhindura CPOE birahagarara gushika uhisemwo ukundi gusura.
clinical_visit_unsign_confirm: Urazi neza ko ushobora gusubiramwo ubitse nk'uko vyashizweko umukono?
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Bika uru rugendo nk'uko rwashizweko umukono? Ivyo ntibishobora gusubirwamwo. Ukwihweza n’uguhindura CPOE bizokurwaho muri uru rugendo; intebe y’akazi y’abaforomo iguma ihari.
observation_emr_diagnosis_not_found: Iyo nkuru y’ugupima iyo ndwara ntiyabonetse.
observation_emr_specialty_empty: Nta vyo kwinjira mu rupapuro rw’ivy’ubuhinga bwihariye.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Itegeko ry’Ukwitwararika ntabwo riboneka muri iyi nyubakwa. Koresha umugambi wo kwitwararika EMR y’ubuvuzi iyo witeguye.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_empty: Nta mugambi wo kwitwararika kwinjira muri uru rugendo.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_not_found: Iyo nyandiko y’umugambi wo kwitwararika ntiyabonetse.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_delete_hint: Iyi nkuru izoshirwako ikimenyetso c'uko idakora.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Ivyiyumviro vy’iterambere ntibiboneka muri iyi nyubakwa. Koresha amakete y’iterambere ry’ubuvuzi EMR iyo yiteguye.
observation_emr_progress_note_delete_hin: Iyi nkuru izoshirwako ikimenyetso c'uko idakora.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Wandike amabwirizwa y'imiti, imiti, ingano, n'impanuro ku murwayi...
consultation_cpoe_prescription_empty: Nta nkuru z’imiti y’uru rugendo ziracariho.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_delete_hi: Iryo kete rizoshirwako ikimenyetso c’uko ridakora.
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Uyu murongo uri ku rupapuro rwa OP rwugarijwe kandi ntushobora guhindurwa canke gukurwaho.
observation_emr_inactivate_hint: Iyi nkuru izoshirwako ikimenyetso c'uko idakora.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Uyu murongo w’itegeko uzoshirwako ikimenyetso c’uko udakora kandi uzokurwa mu gutanga amafaranga y’i OP.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Subira wandike insobanuro y'inyandiko iri musi kugira ngo uhagarike iyi nkuru.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Ivyo bizokuraho konti yabo kandi ntibazosubira kwinjira.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Ibice birahurizwa hamwe kugira ngo haboneke kode imwe imwe. Yongerako umwandiko udahinduka, amakuru, n'umubare uriko uragenda.
prefix_configuration_field_visit_order_k: Nimero yo gusura canke id yo gusura
prefix_configuration_format_empty: Wongereko n’imiburiburi igice kimwe ku buryo bwa kode.
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Uburyo bwabitswe ntibwashoboye gushirwako; guhera ku miterere y'imbere.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Gushinga ingene amakode y’abarwayi, inomero z’ugusura, n’inomero z’amategeko y’ibikorwa vyubatswe. Intumbero yose ikoresha urufunguzo rwa sisitemu rudahinduka; uhindura gusa insobanuro n'imiterere.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Ikoreshwa igihe umuntu yandika abarwayi bashasha. Ubwoko bwo gusura ntibuboneka kuri iyi kode.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Ikoreshwa ku gihe cose umurwayi asuye; harimwo ishami n'ubwoko bw'ugusura iyo ivyo bibanza biri mu buryo.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Ikoreshwa igihe urema amategeko y’ibikorwa. Uburyo mburabuzi bujanye n'YY/gusura/NNN. Hindukiza “Urutonde rutandukanye ku rugendo” kugira ngo inomero z’urutonde ziharure 001, 002... ku rugendo rw’umurwayi (ni vyiza). Iyo izimye, urutonde rusangizwa ku mategeko yose akoresha ibindi bipimo vy'uburebure.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Ikoreshwa igihe umuntu arema ibisabwa vyo kugura (PR). Ivyo ubitunganye imbere y’uko abakozi bashobora gukora PRs.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Ikoreshwa igihe urema amategeko yo kugura (PO). Ivyo ubitunganye imbere y’uko abakozi bashobora gukora ama PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Ikoreshwa igihe urema ibice vy’ishami. Ivyo ubitunganye imbere y'uko abakozi bashobora gukora indents.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Ikoreshwa igihe urema ibibazo vy’amashami kuva hagati gushika ku maduka asaba.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Ikoreshwa igihe umuntu atanga ivyangombwa vy’ikoreshwa ry’ishami kugira ngo vyemezwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Ikoreshwa igihe uzigama amategeko y’imiti yo mu mutima. Imirongo yose mu kubika kumwe isangira iyi nomero y'umugwi. Imbere ikoresha umwaka w'imari, ibitaro, n'urutonde rw'ibikorwa.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Hitamwo ibipimo bigabanya umubare uriko uragenda. Uburyo bwo kwerekana buri hejuru buratandukanye; ivyo bigira ico bikoze gusa ku rugero rw'urutonde rwigenga uronka.
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_visit: Urutonde rutandukanye ku bwoko bwo gusura
inv_grn_api_hint: Rema GRNs biciye ku POST na poId, storeId (hagati), itariki yakiriwe, n'imirongo. Buri murongo: poLineId, purchasedQty (hatarimwo ubuntu), batchNo, itariki y'iherezo, igiciro c'ugugura (bisabwa iyo ikintu gifise ukurikirana kw'umugwi). Ivyiyumviro birasanzwe (ikintu_ivyigwa); ububiko ni buri bubiko n'umugwi (inv_ububiko).
inv_approval_config_intro: Gutunganya ingero z'ukwemererwa n'abashinzwe ububiko n'ubwoko bw'inyandiko wahisemwo haruguru.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Ivyashitse mu bushakashatsi birimwo ivyo biri ku ruhande ku iduka ryatowe (kuva) gusa (igice c'ikibazo iyo kiriho).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: View ifungura iyi nkuru kuri paji yayo bwite; Inyuma iragaruka hano (si ku kibazo c’Igisata).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Imirongo ni `inv_stock` ifatanijwe na `ikintu_umugwi`, itegekanijwe n'igihe co guhera (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Kuyungurura amatsinda y'abakoresha ku izina canke id...
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Injira umubare wemejwe ku murongo nimba ukwiye gutandukanywa n'uwasavye. Pending PR qty ihuriza hamwe imirongo ihuye n’iyi duka isaba (itegerejwe, yoherejwe, canke yemejwe), harimwo n’iki gisaba.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Nta bintu bikiriho. Fyonda + kugira ngo wongereko ikintu, hanyuma ubike urutonde.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Hitamwo igisabwa co kugura cemewe kiri hejuru. Imbonerahamwe izokwinjira hano n'umurongo wose: ikintu, igice (Item Unit Master conversion), umubare usigaye, umubare w'itegeko, n'igiciro c'ikintu.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Hitamwo ikintu mbere, hanyuma uhitemwo igice (uguhindura) mu rutonde rw’igice c’ikintu.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Iki kintu nta mpinduka zikora zifise. Bitunganye munsi y’Itegeko ry’Ibiharuro → Umukuru w’Ibintu.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Hitamwo iduka ry’ugugura ryo hagati mu kabati ko hejuru. Ibisabwa vyemewe ku bijanye n’itegeko rishasha ryo kugura bishirwa ku rutonde gusa igihe iyo duka yatowe: birungikwa mu gugura hagati, ntibirungikwa mu yandi maduka nk’ivuriro ry’imiti ritari CPS yatunganijwe.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Gutegura iduka ry’ugugura ryo hagati munsi y’Itegeko ry’Ibiharuro → Gutegura Ibiharuro vy’Ibitaro imbere yo guhingura amategeko y’ugugura avuye mu bisabwa.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Funga uyu murongo wa PO ushire ikimenyetso ku qty isigaye nk'ipfutse?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Funga uyu murongo wa PR usigaye qty (shiraho open-for-PO kuri 0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Nta duka ry’imbere ryatunganijwe ku bw’ishami ry’iri tegeko ry’ugugura. Ikete ry’ibicuruzwa ritegerezwa gushirwa mw’iduka ry’ishami ry’imbere. Mu gutegura ububiko, shira ikimenyetso neza neza ku iduka rimwe ku ishami nk'iry'imbere (ni iduka ry'imbere), hanyuma wongere ugerageze.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Hitamwo itegeko ryo kugura kugira ngo ubone iduka ryakira.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Umubare w'ibintu, igihe co guhera, n'igiciro co kugura birakenewe ku bikoresho bikurikirana.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Hitamwo vyinshi mu bubiko bw'inkomoko, canke ushiremwo vyinshi umaze guhitamwo amaduka.
inv_hub_subtitle: Amasoko, ububiko, n’uguhindura iki kigo c’ubuvuzi.
inv_hub_card_pr: Gushira hejuru no kwemeza ibisabwa vyo kugura.
inv_hub_card_po: Rema kandi wemeze amategeko yo kugura, wohereze ku baguzi.
inv_hub_card_grn: Kwandika ivyemezo vy’ibicuruzwa ku bijanye n’amategeko y’ugugura.
inv_pr_approve_need_prId: Gufungura iyi paji na ?prId=... muri URL.
inv_po_approve_need_poId: Gufungura iyi paji na ?poId=... muri URL.
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Gugura hagati bishirwa munsi y’ububiko bw’ibitaro config.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: PR, PO, na GRN ku bicuruzwa baguze bakoresha iri duka. Iduka ryatowe ryashizweko ikimenyetso c’uko ari Iduka ry’Igihugu; iyo imbere isubira ku Regular.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Iyo umurongo wuzuye ku bijanye n'itegeko ry'ugugura, umubare wuguruye ni 0 hano; gukurikirana ivyo yasavye, vyakiriwe, n’ivyo bikiriko biraronka ku bimenyetso vya PO na GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Amategeko yo kugura arahari kuri iyi PR ariko urutonde ntirwashoboye gushirwako. Gerageza gusubiramwo iyo paji.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Umurongo wo hejuru ushiraho ububiko bwawe / usaba (kuva) mu bubiko. Urutonde rwerekana ibisabwa n’iryo duka. Hitamwo Amaduka yose kugira ngo ubone ibisabwa n'iduka ryose risaba, canke ukoreshe akayunguruzo k'inkingi y'iduka kugira ngo ugabanye n'Ibivuye mu iduka.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Ivy’ububiko bigarukira ku iduka riri mu bar yo hejuru. Hitamwo Amaduka yose kugira ngo ubone iduka ryose riri mu bitaro.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Urutonde ruragarukira ku bimenyetso vyashizweho n’iduka riri mu murongo wo hejuru. Hitamwo Amaduka yose kugira ngo ubone amashami yose.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Rema igisabwa co kugura mu iduka risaba (umurongo wo hejuru) → umaze kwemererwa, rema itegeko ryo kugura maze ushire GRN mw’iduka ryakira → kuri list ya GRN, ukoreshe Transfer kugira ngo wimure ibintu vyakiriwe mw’iduka ryafunguye igisabwa (igihe PR ihuye na PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Kuva mw’iduka biva ku bar yo hejuru. Hitamwo a Kubika iki gisaba.
inv_flow_po_context: POs z’iduka ryatowe (umurongo wo hejuru) zikurikira ibisabwa vyo kugura vyemewe canke kwinjira n’amaboko; kwemeza hanyuma wohereze ku muguzi imbere y’uko ibicuruzwa vyakira.
inv_flow_grn_context: Shira amafaranga y’ivyemezo mu iduka ry’ivyemezo (ibarabara ryo hejuru). Iyo PO ihuye n’ivyo usaba, koresha Transfer kugira ngo wohereze ibintu ku iduka risaba umaze gushiramwo GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Hitamwo iduka riri hejuru kugira ngo wibande kuri uru rutonde, canke ukoreshe Amategeko yose yo kugura mu bitaro iyo ata duka ryatowe.
inv_grn_col_retransfer: Gusubira kwimurira mu bubiko bwa PR
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Iduka ryo hagati (umurongo wo hejuru = Kuva mu iduka) rivyura ibibazo ku maduka asaba: haba bivuye ku nsiguro y’ishami yemejwe irindiriye gushitsa, canke n’amaboko ata nsiguro.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Nk’amategeko yo kugura: koresha New from department indent igihe ibintu bisabwa mw’iduka ryawe ry’agaciro biciye ku indent; koresha Igitabo iyo ata n'imwe irimwo.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Guhindura “Kuva mw’iduka” mu murongo wo hejuru (iruhande y’ishami / umugwi w’abakoresha) igihe igice c’Ibiharuro kifunguye.
inv_dept_issue_pending_indents_help: Ivyo bimenyetso vyemezwa n’iduka risaba kandi birindiriye ko ufungura ikibazo c’ishami. Hitamwo iduka ryo hagati mu kabati ko hejuru.
inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Rema ikibazo c’ishami uhereye ku rutonde → ikibazo c’ishami → Igishasha kivuye mu gice c’isoko (iduka ryo hagati ritegerezwa guhura n’iduka ry’iyi “ku” riri mu murongo wo hejuru).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Hitamwo ububiko bwo hagati (buzuza) mu murongo wo hejuru. Urutonde rwerekana ibibazo aho iyo duka ari yo itanga (Kuva).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Wemere ko wakiriye ku iduka usavye (kuva mu kabare). Ivyiyumviro vyasohowe biraboneka hano gushika bishikirijwe.
inv_di_cancel_reason_prompt: Injira imvo yo gukuraho iyi nkuru.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Hitamwo iduka ryawe usaba mu murongo wo hejuru kugira ngo ubone urutonde rw'ibice birindiriye kwakirwa muri iryo duka.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Ikoreshwa ry'inyandiko ku iduka n'ibigabanywa ku rugero rw'umugwi. Gutanga kugira ngo vyemezwe; kwemezwa kwa nyuma gushiraho ugukoresha no kugabanya ivy’ububiko.
inv_dc_list_scope_hint: Urutonde rushobora gukurikira iduka riri mu murongo wo hejuru canke rwerekana amaduka yose.
inv_dc_configure_dc_approvers: Gutegura abavyemeza ibikorwa vy’ishami (module DC) vy’iri duka mu Gutegura Ivy’Ibiharuro → Gutegura ivyemezo.
inv_dc_modal_batch_help: Ivyimburwa bishirwa mu bubiko ku iduka ryatoranijwe ry’iki kintu.
inv_dc_batch_table_empty: Nta batches zifise ububiko muri iri duka.
inv_dc_batch_qty_exceeds_stock: Igitigiri kirenze ivy’ububiko biriho ku bijanye n’umugwi umwe canke myinshi.
medication_order_internal_sales_empty: Nta kugurisha imbere mu gihugu kuracariho.

med_order_int_delete_confirm: Gukuraho batch yose n’imirongo yayo yose? Ivyo ntibishobora gusubirwamwo.
med_order_int_no_batches: Nta miti yazigamye ku bijanye n’uru rugendo.

med_order_int_reorder_line_appended: Itegeko rishasha ryazigamye n’inomero nshasha y’umugwi.

inv_reorder_level_min_qty_conversion_hin: Injira umubare mutoyi mu bice vy’ugugura; ibikwa nk'umubare w'ububiko (ikibazo) hakoreshejwe uguhindura kwatowe.

inv_stock_alert_policy_hint: Amadirisho y'iherezo ry'ikintu cose ashobora gushirwa ku Mukuru w'Ikintu (ahindura ivy'ibitaro biri musi).
inv_stock_alert_policy_email_channels: Imburi zo muri porogaramu zikurikira utuzu tw'abaronka gusa. Kugira ngo ubone imeli, fungura ubwoko bwose bw’imburi hano (bwabitswe), ushireho SMTP kuri server, kandi urabe ko umukozi wese afise aderesi y’imeli.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_days: Imisi izohera vuba itegerezwa kuba iri hagati ya 1 na 365.
inv_stock_alert_invalid_gap: Iminota yo gukonja itegerezwa kuba nibura 1.
inv_stock_alert_recipients_hint: Umurongo wose ni iduka rimwe n’umukozi umwe. Ivyibutsa bivuga gusa ibicuruzwa vy’iduka: bihure n’inkingi y’Iduka iri kuri raporo y’ibicuruzwa bike. Koresha amasandugu y’ibintu bike / Bizohera vuba ku murongo; Policy nayo irafise ama email atandukanye. Abakozi bashinzwe ibitaro ni bo bonyene bashobora kwongerwako.
inv_stock_alert_recipient_exists: Uwo mukozi asanzwe ari ku rutonde rw’iri duka.
inv_stock_alert_cron_body: Kugira ngo ubone imburi n’imeli ku gihe, hamagara iyi nzira ku rutonde (nk’akarorero buri minota 15). Koresha email=1 gusa iyo SMTP itunganijwe.
inv_stock_alert_cron_secret: Wohereze umutwe Uruhusha: Uwutwara <CRON_IBANGA> canke x-cron-ibanga. Gushinga CRON_SECRET mu bidukikije vya server.
inv_store_markup_percent_invalid: Igiharuro c'ububiko kigomba kuba hagati ya 0 na 999.
inv_pricing_template_subtitle: Amafomula y’igiciro c’ugurisha ashobora gusubirwamwo (MSL, amabendera y’igiciro). Guha ishami n'ibice ku bijanye n'imiterere y'ibiciro.
inv_pricing_assignment_subtitle: Hitamwo urugero rumwe rw'imirongo ku ishami n'igice c'ugurisha. Ugurisha n’ugutanga bikoresha urugero rwatanzwe ku gihe c’ugucuruza.
inv_pricing_assignment_unassigned_warnin: Nta n’akarorero kagenewe: ugurisha kw’iki kiganiro kuri iri shami kuzonanirwa gushika ushizeho kimwe.

inv_pricing_config_branch_locked_hint: Gukoresha ishami rivuye ku murongo wo kugenderamwo: {branch}. Hitamwo “Amashami yose” muri nav kugira uhitemwo ishami ritandukanye hano.

inv_pricing_config_emp_help_manual: Injira igiciro c’ugurisha c’abakozi ku murongo wose wa GRN igihe utangaza.

home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Ibikorwa vy'ibitaro bitekanye ku mugwi wose witaho
home_seo_description: Medora ni EMR y’ibitaro vyinshi yo kwandika, gusura, gukora ibikorwa vy’ubuvuzi, gukora urutonde, no gutwara. Console imwe ya Soft Wash y’abafise amazu, abakozi, n’abajejwe kwitwararika.
home_hero_headline: Guhindura imisi yo mu bitaro mu gutuza, guhuza
home_hero_body: Medora: ibikorwa vyo kwitwararika ibitaro vyinshi n’ukwiyandikisha, gusura, intebe z’akazi z’ubuvuzi, n’ivy’ubuhinga mu kibanza kimwe c’abakodesha.
home_how_heading: Kuva ku kwandikisha gushika ku rugendo rwugarijwe
home_how_lead: Imwe mu nzira z’abaza n’abaje kwitaho. Yubatswe kubera ibihe amashirahamwe mu vy’ukuri yimura abarwayi.
home_how_step1_body: Fata akaranga, allergies, n’amateka rimwe. Igihe cose umuntu asuye mu nyuma, asubira gukoresha iyo mbonerahamwe nyene.
home_how_step2_body: Rema OP canke IP visits, ushireko amasaha, kandi ugume ufise ivyerekeye ishami bitomoye ku bijanye n’ivyo uvuga.
home_how_step3_body: Ivy’ingenzi vy’ubuvuzi, ibipimo, amategeko y’imiti, n’inyandiko bibaho ku rutonde rumwe rw’igihe co gusura.
home_how_step4_body: Ibibazo vy’ububiko, gutanga amafaranga, n’intambwe zo gusohora biguma bifitaniye isano n’inyandiko y’urugendo.
home_modules_lead: Amapaki y’ubushobozi atwikira amamesa ategerezwa kuguma ahuye: ibiro vy’imbere, amagorofa y’ubuvuzi, amaduka, n’ubuyobozi.
home_modules_registration_body: Umurwayi umukuru, irema ry'urugendo, amasaha, n'ishami-bizi gusuzuma.
home_modules_clinical_body: Ivyigwa vy’ubuvuzi n’ivy’ugusaba inama birimwo ivy’agaciro, ivy’ugupima, amategeko, n’amakete ya EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Amaduka, ibice, PR/PO/GRN, ugukoresha kw’ishami, n’imburi z’ububiko.
home_modules_admin_body: Abakozi, amashami, amatsinda y'abakoresha, abakuru, inyandiko, n'imiterere y'ibitaro.
home_model_heading: SaaS imwe. Ibitaro vyinshi. Uruhara rutomoye.
home_model_lead: Medora ni ibitaro vyinshi kubera ubuhinga. Ico kibanza ni co kirema ibitaro. Ibitaro birarongora ubuvuzi. Abarwayi ntibakeneye kwigera bakenera ibiro vyawe vy’inyuma.
home_model_platform_body: Abarongozi ba sisitemu bafise imbuto, ibitaro, n’ibihome vy’uburinzi umukodesha wese asangira.
home_model_hospital_body: Ba nyen'amazu n'abarongozi baratunganya amashami, amaduka, abakozi bashobora kuronka, n'aba shefu.
home_model_staff_body: Abaforomo, abaganga, n’imigwi y’amaduka bakora bakoresheje ibice bimenya uruhara biri hasi.
home_model_patients_body: Ivyandiko, ingendo n’inyandiko biguma mu bitaro; abakozi bakorera bavuye kuri konsole.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Ivy’ingenzi, ivy’umubiri, amakete y’ubuvuzi, n’ibikorwa vyo ku buriri ata kuva ku rugendo.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Ivyigwa, amategeko y’imiti, n’inyandiko z’ubuvuzi zo ku meza y’umuganga.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Kwakira, gutanga, kwimurira, no kugenzura ububiko n'ubumenyi bw'ibice n'igihe co guhera.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Abakozi, amashami, amatsinda yo gushikira, abakuru b'inyandiko, n'imiterere.
home_integrated_heading: Gumana ameza yose ku rutonde rumwe rw'igihe
home_integrated_lead: Amasaha yo guhura, imiti, inyandiko, n’uguhindura ibintu birasangira urugendo kugira ngo hasi hagume hahuye.
home_cta_body: Injira muri console ya Medora, uhitemwo ibitaro, hanyuma utangure ku bice ikipe yawe isanzwe ikoresha.
home_footer_tagline: Ibikorwa vy'ibitaro vyo kwandika, kwitaho abarwayi, gupima no gucungera.
home_footer_copyright: © {year} Igitabo c’Ivyabona vya Yehova. Porogaramu y’ukwitwararika yakozwe na Menzies.
home_scene_aria: Igishushanyo c'ibitaro biri iruhande y'ibiti mu rugo rutekanye
pricing_seo_title: Igiciro ca Menzies Medora | Igicu n'aho hantu
pricing_seo_description: Igiciro ca EMR c’ibitaro vya Medora: Igicu kuva ku madolari 99/mo (Intango gushika ku rubuga). On-premise ikoresha izo tiers nyene kugiciro ca Cloud + $150/mo kugira ngo uyishire ku bikorwa remezo vyawe. Ukwandikisha, ubuvuzi, urutonde, n'ubuyobozi.
pricing_lead: Igicu SaaS canke On-premise ku bikorwa remezo vyawe. Intango imwe, Ubucuruzi, Urugero, n'Ivyicaro vy'Ikibanza. Ingano y’ibitaro n’ibice, si amaganya y’umubare w’abagendera.
pricing_lead_cloud: Igicu kirakira Soft Wash Medora: SaaS y’ibitaro vyinshi, ivyagezwe bicungiwe, n’ibikorwa remezo bisangiye ku rubuga rwose ukoresha.
pricing_lead_onprem: On-premise ni izo nzira nyene z'ibicuruzwa, zishizweho kandi zishizweho ku maserukira yawe, urutonde rw'amakuru, n'urubuga. Ivyo bikorwa remezo ni mwebwe mufise. Urutonde rw’ukwezi ni Cloud + ${premium} kubera iyo nshingano.
pricing_lead_mmk: Kwerekana MMK ku 1 USD = {rate} MMK kugira ngo ugereranye mu karere.
pricing_lead_usd: USD ibiciro vy'urutonde rw'imigwi y'isi yose.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline: Ibitaro bimwe ku bwakiranywe Soft Wash Medora.
pricing_plan_starter_tagline_onprem: Ibitaro bimwe Soft Wash Medora ku bikorwa remezo vyanyu.
pricing_plan_starter_f6_onprem: Gushigikira imeyili; Ivyagezwe ku nzira yawe yo kurekura
pricing_plan_business_tagline: Ivyuma vyuzuye vy’ibitaro vy’imigwi y’abajejwe kwitwararika iriko irakura.
pricing_plan_business_tagline_onprem: Igitero c’ibitaro cuzuye gishizwe kuri infra yawe.
pricing_plan_business_f1: Gushika ku bitaro 3 ku SaaS yakira
pricing_plan_business_f1_onprem: Gushika ku bitaro 3 ku bikorwa remezo vyanyu
pricing_plan_scale_tagline_onprem: Ibitaro vyinshi ops ku infra yawe n’ubufatanye.
pricing_plan_scale_f7: Ihamagara ryo kwinjira mu ndege ririmwo
pricing_plan_platform_tagline: Abakoresha barongoye ibitaro vyinshi vya Cloud.
pricing_plan_platform_tagline_onprem: Aba operateur barongoye ibitaro vyinshi kuri infra yanyu.
pricing_plan_platform_f1: Ibitaro bitagira aho bigarukira munsi y'urubuga rumwe
pricing_plan_platform_f6_onprem: Ubutumwa bwinshi n'uburaro bukomeye ku rubuga rwawe
pricing_who_heading: Igaragajwe ku citegererezo co kwitwararika Medora
pricing_who_lead: Platform, ibitaro, abakozi, n’abarwayi umwe wese aronka umurongo utomoye. Hitamwo Cloud canke On-premise, hanyuma ushiremwo urugero rumwe rujanye n’ibitaro n’ibice ukoresha.
pricing_who_platform_body: Abakoresha batera imbuto mu bitaro vyinshi kandi bakeneye white-label hamwe n’i SSO. Hitamwo Urubuga ku Gicu canke Ku nzu.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Ba nyen'amazu n'abarongozi batunganya amashami, amaduka, abakozi bashobora kuronka, n'aba shefu. Ubucuruzi canke Urugero bihuye n’imigwi myinshi y’imbuga nyinshi.
pricing_who_staff_body: Abaforomo, abaganga, n’imigwi y’ububiko ku bice bimenya uruhara. Ivyicaro vy’imipaka bigereranywa n’umugambi; abarwayi ntibabona ibiro vy’inyuma.
pricing_who_patients_body: Ivyandiko, ingendo n’inyandiko biguma mu bitaro. Abakozi bakora kuva kuri console gushika mu kwandikisha gushika mu gufunga.
pricing_faq_q1: Mbega igiciro ni ku rugendo canke ku ntebe y’abakozi?
pricing_faq_a1: Ivyiyumviro vyasohowe ni ku mugwi w’ibitaro ufise ibipfukisho vy’ibitaro n’ivy’ivyicaro. Igicu na On-premise gusangira Intango, Ubucuruzi, Urugero, n'Ikibanza. Urutonde rw'ukwezi rwo mu nzu ni Cloud + $150. Nta n’imwe muri izo nzira ikoresha igipimo c’ugusura ku misi y’ibikorwa vyinshi.
pricing_faq_a2: Ivy’ugutanga amafaranga y’umwaka bifunga mu mwaka ushobora gutegekanirwa wa Soft Wash Medora. Ibitaro vy’umuco wa Loomline SaaS akenshi bigabanya imigambi y’umwaka nk’ibice 15 gushika kuri 20%. Medora itanga 20% ku rutonde rw’ukwezi iyo urishe umwaka wose, ku gicu no ku kibanza (inyuma y’igiciro ca +$150 ku kibanza).
pricing_faq_a3: Intango irimwo ukwandikisha kw’ishimikiro, gusura, n’intebe z’akazi z’ubuvuzi zifise urutonde rw’ishimikiro. Ubucuruzi no hejuru gufungura ububiko bwose bw'ibikorwa, amategeko y'imiti ahuye n'ububiko, n'imiterere y'ubuyobozi butunze. Baza igihe ukeneye ivyongeweko bitegekanijwe.
pricing_faq_q4: Ibiciro vyo kw’isi yose n’ivyo muri Myanmar?
pricing_faq_a4: Koresha isoko toggle hejuru y'imigambi. Global yerekana USD gusa. Myanmar yerekana MMK ku madolari 1 = 5000 MMK (USD ari umurongo wa kabiri). Igihe co gutanga amafaranga n’uburyo bwo gutanga serivisi bitandukanye n’isoko.
pricing_faq_a5: Igicu kirakira Soft Wash Medora: SaaS y’ibitaro vyinshi, ivyagezwe bishasha, n’ugutangura vyihuta. On-premise ikoresha izo tiers nyene, zishirwa ku bikorwa remezo vyawe igihe ukeneye kugenzura canke kuba. Infra ni iyawe; urutonde rw’ukwezi ni Cloud + $150 kubera iyo nshingano.
pricing_trial_lead: Mutubwire ivyerekeye ibitaro vyanyu n’igihe mukeneye. Tuzokurikirana kuri email.
pricing_trial_message_placeholder: Imbuga, umuzigo w'isonga, Igicu canke ihitamwo ryo mu nzu...
pricing_trial_success: Igisabwa c’urubanza carakiriwe. Tuzokurikirana kuri email vuba.
pricing_trial_error_duration: Hitamwo igihe co kugerageza: imisi 7, indwi 2, canke ukwezi kumwe.
pricing_trial_error_send: Ntiyashobora kohereza igisabwa cawe. Subira ugerageze hanyuma.
